title: Copula and MOFA+ integration of simulated blood multiomics
author: Vusumuzi Mabasa
disclosure: Entirely synthetic data; no TACA, Clin-MAP or patient data used.
diagnostic_policy: Copula Rhat >=1.1 triggers a prespecified same-seed rerun with three times burn and draws. Retain and report unresolved flags. MOFA convergence requires official Converged message. Failures remain in denominators. No performance-driven scenario or seed changes.
limitations: Synthetic countries are not named African populations
